    "summary": "The investigation board shows that at ~10:00 AM on May 20, 2024, a two-person Utilities crew (U-A/U-B) experienced an instrument-air interruption while preparing the #1 slab caster compressor/dryer system for maintenance. The boundary was not yet released (maintenance acceptance signature pending), and no evidence confirms whether recent service-routing changes were briefed or if the correct configuration drawing was used. This leaves open hypotheses of unrecorded routing changes, outdated drawings, or upstream supply disturbances.",

    ],
    "alternatives": [
      "Upstream utility outage unrelated to configuration or maintenance boundary state.",
